name: portraiture
description: Run dependency-free environment collection scripts and capture their output.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:ts && npm run test:python && npm run test:csharp && npm run test:go && npm run test:elixir && npm run test:powershell && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=python/src python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s python/tests
